# T6.2 (TASKS.md) -- DESIGN.md §3 degenerate-case table, row "No eligible
# heir (all unstable/lagging)": every follower fails the eligibility gate
# at selection time, so selectHeir finds nothing, no announcement goes out,
# and every node's timeout falls back to the plain vanilla formula --
# stock Raft, byte-for-byte, even though HeirElection is on.
#
# max-heir-lag=1 on the leader makes the lag gate trivial to fail: two
# proposals are flushed into the leader's own log (bumping lastIndex by 2)
# but deliberately never delivered to either follower before the heartbeat
# tick runs selection, so both followers' Match still sits two entries
# behind -- lag=2 > max-heir-lag=1 for both, simultaneously. (Not
# max-heir-lag=0: Config.validate(), raft.go:421-422, treats a zero
# MaxHeirLag as "unset" and silently defaults it to 256, same as every
# other zero-value tunable in this Config -- passing 0 here would leave
# the real bound at 256 and every lag in this test comfortably eligible.)

log-level error
----
ok

add-nodes 1 voters=(1,2,3) index=2 heir-election=true stability-score=50 max-heir-lag=1
----
ok

add-nodes 1 voters=(1,2,3) index=2 heir-election=true stability-score=255
----
ok

add-nodes 1 voters=(1,2,3) index=2 heir-election=true stability-score=100
----
ok

campaign 1
----
ok

# Both followers fully caught up here (lag=0, passes max-heir-lag=1) --
# this establishes the baseline before the lag is introduced.
propose 1 foo
----
ok

# Flush only the leader's own Ready (bumps its lastIndex and queues the
# MsgApp to 2 and 3), without delivering anything -- both followers' Match
# stays at the pre-propose index.
process-ready 1
----
Ready MustSync=true:
Entries:
1/4 EntryNormal "foo"
Messages:
1->2 MsgApp Term:1 Log:1/3 Commit:3 Entries:[1/4 EntryNormal "foo"]
1->3 MsgApp Term:1 Log:1/3 Commit:3 Entries:[1/4 EntryNormal "foo"]

propose 1 bar
----
ok

process-ready 1
----
Ready MustSync=true:
Entries:
1/5 EntryNormal "bar"
Messages:
1->2 MsgApp Term:1 Log:1/4 Commit:3 Entries:[1/5 EntryNormal "bar"]
1->3 MsgApp Term:1 Log:1/4 Commit:3 Entries:[1/5 EntryNormal "bar"]

# selectHeir runs synchronously inside this tick, against the lastIndex/
# Match values as they stand right now: both followers are 2 entries
# behind, past max-heir-lag=1. Neither is eligible.
tick-heartbeat 1
----
ok

# No heir=/churn= line -- HeirElection is on, but nobody qualified, so
# nothing was ever announced. Output is byte-identical to the
# HeirElection=off case for exactly that reason.
status 1
----
1: StateReplicate match=5 next=6
2: StateReplicate match=3 next=6 score=255 inflight=2
3: StateReplicate match=3 next=6 score=100 inflight=2

# The undelivered MsgApp messages are flushed now, only to confirm the
# cluster is otherwise perfectly healthy -- this scenario is about heir
# selection finding nobody, not about the cluster being broken.
